title: Positive lower density of large prime gaps

result.label: Positive lower density of large prime gaps
result.statement: For every fixed C > 0, a positive proportion of consecutive prime gaps exceed C pn, throughout every sufficiently large initial segment of the primes. The proportion may depend on C . Consequently, the indices where pn/n increases have positive lower density, answering Erdős and Prachar.
